movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Gestures emulate throwing spears or hunting.
movement_profile.footwork: Includes jumps and tiptoe movements; ankle hooves provide percussive sound.

signature_moves.description: High jumps reaching up to one meter.
signature_moves.name: Cambá

music_profile.sound_description: Originally flute-based (pinquillos and quenas), the modern sound is defined by agile brass instrumentation.

basic_steps: Camba: High jumps reaching up to one meter.
Chucu-chucu: Rapid rhythm performed on tiptoes.
Paso de la flecha: War-themed step representing courage.
teaching.level_notes: Requires high physical strength, stamina, and coordination.
